identity: An Arabic sports-magazine page (المجلة الرياضية, compiled by خالد فؤاد) containing two run-together pieces in journalistic MSA. Piece 1 (tokens 0-964) is a preview-plus-history feature on the 14th AFC Asian Cup 2007: masthead, byline, two decks/subheads, an expository block on the tournament format, then a year-by-year chronicle of editions 1-13, the 2007 scheduling change, the entrant list, the group draw, a UAE-specific section under its own subhead, and finally a four-line stat box (ثلاثة منتخبات فقط... / Iran / Saudi / Japan). Piece 2 (tokens 966-1487) is a short opinion-report headlined ضرب الحكام ظاهرة خطيرة on assaults against referees: a problem statement, a numbered five-part apportionment of blame (أولا...خامسا), the Denmark-Sweden Euro 2008 qualifier incident with referee Herbert Fandel, and two blocks of quoted speech. Text has some source noise: a dittographic repeat of بين 2 ديسمبر و 18 ديسمبر at 292-303 and a stray scoreline 3 3 at 935-936.
law: The unit is the orthographic sentence the sub-editor would have closed with a full stop, not the clause. Positive triggers, in order of strength: (1) asyndetic juxtaposition of two finite independent clauses, i.e. a complete predication followed with no connector by a fresh verb-initial or topic-initial clause (71, 93, 282, 1442, 1445, 1461) - this is the single most reliable signal in a de-punctuated Arabic text; (2) a fronted temporal/locative frame opening a NEW event in a chronicle - في عام X أقيمت / وفي عام X / وفي بطولة / ففي الفترة / وأقيمت البطولة الـ N - each edition of the cup is its own sentence (221, 282, 311, 376, 708, 776, 816); (3) sentence-initial discourse operators that scope over a whole new proposition: كما + full clause (80, 476, 572, 767), لذا (551), أما...فـ (177), explanatory فـ + new nominal maxim (1133); (4) waw + a re-mentioned or new overt subject introducing a DISTINCT fact rather than another predicate of the same event (131, 748, 1019, 1386). Negative rules, which matter as much: waw that merely chains further predicates of one and the same event, result or enumeration is NOT a boundary (واستمرت, وفاز بها, واستطاع, وشارك فيها); the adversatives لكن / لكنه / غير أن / إلا أن are intra-sentential in this register and never license a cut (1106, 834, 869, 1452, 1470); subordinators حيث, عندما, مثلما, خاصة أن, بعدما, لأن, التي/الذي bind their clause to the matrix; the tail-resumptive وذلك بسبب continues its sentence (528); a verbless fragment is not made a sentence just because a connective precedes it (كذلك منتخب البحرين at 465); and the colon slot after a quotative قال ... معلقا or after an appositive label is not a full stop. Structurally: every token immediately preceding <NL> and the final token close a sentence by fiat; an <NL> itself never carries one. The resulting density is ~22 real tokens per sentence, which matches the register.
reasoning: FORMAT BLOCK. 40 <NL> tokens give 40 forced pre-newline boundaries plus the final token 1487 = 41 fixed cuts; the 25 remaining decisions are all paragraph-internal. Short paragraphs that are titles, decks or stat-box lines (0-1, 3-5, 7-18, 20-28, 666-672, 938-946, 948-952, 954-958, 960-964, 966-969) are single units and need nothing added. HARD SITE 71/80/93 (format-explanation block 59-104). من المعروف أن ... قبل بداية البطولة is complete at 71; تتأهل المنتخبات ... follows asyndetically with a fresh verb and subject. It could also be read as a descriptive gloss on تصفيات (comma), so I cut at 71 but only at lo. كما يوجد دور أول at 81 is a scope-taking new proposition, so 80 cuts. At 93 the question is whether أيضا closes the يقسم clause or opens the next; أيضا is post-positive in MSA, so it closes, and يتأهل الأفضل opens a new sentence. HARD SITE 131. In 106-143 I rejected a cut at 119 (واستمرت is another predicate of the same 1956 edition) but accepted 131: وتأهل يومها منتخب هونج كونج تلقائيا is a different fact with a different subject and its own causal tail. HARD SITE 177 vs 191. أما البطولة الخامسة فأقيمت is a topic-shift frame and gets the cut at 177; وشاركت في البطولة منتخبات ... at 192 is an enumerative tail on the same edition, so 191 is left uncut. CHRONICLE SPINE 221/282/311/376. The chronicle's grammar is one edition = one sentence, marked by وفي عام 1980, في البطولة التاسعة (asyndetic), وأقيمت البطولة العاشرة, وأقيمت البطولة الثانية عشرة. These are the highest-confidence internal cuts in the document. Correspondingly I did NOT cut before وفاز بها / واستطاع / وتمكن (242, 428), which report the result of the edition just named - 252-282 proves the pattern, since واستطاع المنتخب السعودي there is plainly inside the 1984 sentence. The dittography at 292-303 gets no cut. HARD SITE 464 vs 476. Both كذلك and كما look like openers, but كذلك منتخب البحرين الذي ... has no main predicate - it hangs off كان من أبرز نتائج - so it is a comma-joined item, while كما وصل منتخب الأردن is a full verbal clause. Cut 476 only. HARD SITE 551/572. لذا تقرر and كما سيشارك منتخب أستراليا both open new propositions after complete ones; وذلك بسبب at 528 does not. Paragraphs 589-628 and 630-664 are single enumerations (entrants; group draw) and take no internal cut at all despite being 40 and 35 tokens. HARD SITE 708-816, the 157-token UAE paragraph, the densest in the document. 708: وعلاقة كرة الإمارات ... طويلة وطيبة is a complete thesis sentence and ففي الفترة من 16 إلى 25 نوفمبر is its evidential expansion - clear cut. 748: وتكرر إنجاز التأهل مرة ثانية moves to 1984 after a 40-token 1979-80 sentence. 767: كما تأهل للمرة الثالثة (1988). 776: وفي بطولة عام 1992 - fronted frame. Inside the 1992 sentence I rejected 799 (وصعد المنتخب continues the same campaign, and لكنه that follows is intra-sentential). The genuinely awkward site is 811/816: وتتواصل مرحلة التفوق الإماراتي آسيويا is only 5 tokens and could either close the 1992 sentence or stand alone as a bridge. I cut 816 with high confidence because وفي نهائيات ... عام 1996 is the document's signature new-edition frame, and I cut 811 only at lo. Inside 817-857 I refused 834 (غير أن) and 844 (واحتل ... المركز الثاني is the outcome of the same final). 881-936 is one long sentence: خاصة أن and وبعد أن are both subordinate, and 935-936 is stray. PIECE 2. 971-1006 is one sentence under حيث. 1019: وبعدما يعتدون ... يقولون is a fronted-subordinate + main clause, the canonical MSA sentence opening, so I cut, at med. 1034-1097 is a single 64-token sentence welded by لا ... فقط بل ... مثلما حدث ... عندما ... بعد - no cut anywhere. 1099-1119 stays whole because لكن does not break. THE FIVE ORDINAL LABELS. أولا اللاعب / ثانيا حكم المباراة / ثالثا مدرب الفريق / رابعا الجمهور / خامسا لجنة التنظيم are run-in labels, so I tested each syntactically rather than applying one blanket rule. ثالثا: مدرب الفريق هو الذي ... is a cleft with the label as its subject - no cut. ثانيا: وعليه continues the label appositively - no cut. رابعا and خامسا: الجمهور مشجعو الفريق and لجنة التنظيم منظمو البطولات both read cleanly as apposition, so no cut. أولا is the exception: apposition would give اللاعب، أول من يتحمل المسئولية ... هو اللاعب نفسه, a double subject with the noun repeated, so the label must be closed off - cut 1122. Also 1133, where فاللاعب المثالي هو الذي is a fresh general maxim after a completed assertion. 1215-1248 stays whole because مشجعو الفريق الذين ... has no predicate until فإذا ... فإن, so cutting at 1230 would strand a headless topic. 1274-1312 is one كان ... قد frame; I rejected 1307 since وكانت النتيجة التعادل 3 3 is the same incident's score. QUOTED SPEECH. In 1314-1341 I rejected 1322: فإننا grounds the immediately preceding wish and the whole quote is only 28 tokens - a comma reading wins, though this is my closest call among the rejections. In 1343-1413 I cut 1386, since وأشار الحكم إلى ضربة جزاء re-mentions the subject and starts the causal chain that produces the pitch invasion, after a 44-token sentence that had already closed on منطقة جزاء الدانمارك. The final paragraph 1415-1487 is where asyndesis is decisive: after وقال معلقا (a colon slot, not a stop) the quote runs لا أفهم ... بهذه الطريقة | المباراة كانت رائعة | كانت عبارة عن مهرجان هجومي ... | أعترف بأنني أصبت بالصدمة, four clauses butted together with no connector at 1442, 1445 and 1461. The two لكن clauses (1453, 1471) are held inside their sentences per the adversative rule. Net: 25 internal cuts, 66 total, ~22 real tokens per sentence.
